basic_info.description: 1788 Clay St #103 is a sophisticated loft-style, corner unit with a deeded patio at The Marlow. The open floor plan offers seamless living between the kitchen, dining and living areas which is ideal for entertaining. Dramatic, oversized windows accent the 15ft+ ceilings and provide plenty of natural light. The kitchen features high-end S/S appliances with designer finishes and the spacious bath offers a serene, spa-like ambiance. There is also a walk-in closet, in-unit laundry and 1-car deeded parking. Located at the juncture of three of the city's most desirable neighborhoods: Nob Hill, Russian Hill & Pacific Heights. The Marlow exceeds expectations with modern conveniences like air conditioning, an attended lobby with secure package area and a common courtyard equipped with fire-pit, BBQ, lounge areas and bocce ball court. 99 Walk Score!
